column1: Table 5.3.2: Allocation, Release and Expenditure under National Horticulture Mission for North East and Himalayan States
Note: - expenditure reported includes unspent balance of previous financial year and provisional.

During 2016-17 an amount of Rs.47.89 Crore, during 2017-18 an amount of Rs.75.00 Crore, during 2018-19 an amount of Rs.75.00 Crore, during 2020-21 an amount of Rs.57.18 Crore, during 2021-22 an amount of Rs.74.82 Crore and during 2022-23 an amount of Rs.40.00 Crore released for Prime Minister's Development Package 2015 to J&K.
During 2021-22 an amount of Rs.16.82 Crore and during 2022-23 an amount of Rs.12.00 Crore had been released under PMDP to UT of Ladakh.
During 2018-19, an additional amount of Rs.56.03 Crore had been released to mitigate the floods in Kerala.
During 2018-19, an additional amount of Rs.50.00 Crore had been released to mitigate Gaja Cyclone in Tamil Nadu
During 2017-18, an additional amount of Rs.10.14 Crore had been released to Himachal Pradesh to clear the pending liability.
